summary: Implemented the issue #201 refactor in the MONAI repo at run-04/generated, without committing or running any code. Changes: new monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver) and monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) hold the saving logic previously inside SegmentationSaver and ClassificationSaver. monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gains plot_2d_or_3d_image, moved from TensorBoardImageHandler._add_2_or_3_d. The handlers keep their constructors and ignite attach wiring and delegate to the new code. New unit tests: tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. docs/source/data.rst lists the new modules. Behaviour change to review: SegmentationSaver now honours its dtype argument (default float32), where it previously saved with the data's own dtype. Pre-existing quirk kept: the 3D multi-channel TensorBoard branch plots only the first channel. Not verified: the tests and linter have not been run; checks were by reading only.
